title: jevlint error
description: What `--format=json` prints on stdout, with exit 2, when a run could not start: a bad option, a missing or unreadable file, a config or catalogue that does not load, or no API key. A run that started and then lost a call prints a report instead, with `summary.complete` false.

kind.description: What kind of thing was wrong, so a caller can branch without reading the message.

message.description: Written for a person, and the only field that names the specific thing at fault.

command.description: The command that was asked for, including one that does not exist.
